prompt: Round 4 of 6. The company side proposes (We accept 30-day review in trade for moving to uni_owns_option_to_assign, which gives us a path to take over the IP out

content.text:
The company wants uni_owns_option_to_assign. I want uni_owns_option_to_licence. I can accept option_to_assign as it still keeps university ownership unless/until the option is exercised, preserving academic use. But I'd prefer option_to_licence. Let me hold at uni_owns_option_to_licence and offer something else, or accept if this meets my needs.

uni_owns_option_to_assign means university owns, company has option to take over fully. If exercised, university loses ownership and publication rights could be at risk. My hard interest is publication rights. I should counter-propose keeping uni_owns_option_to_licence.
As a trade-off, I could offer to shorten the exclusivity period to 12 months in exchange for retaining option_to_licence.
